name: external-link-dialog
title: External link dialog
description: The pause before leaving your site through a user-supplied link: it shows the real destination, says it is not yours, and offers Continue or Go back.
docs: Give it a trigger and an href for one link, or wrap content with intercept and every link inside that leaves your site asks first (your own origin, mailto, tel and trustedHosts pass through; a javascript or data link is stopped). A plain click is caught; a click with a modifier key goes through. The dialog says "This link goes to another website", shows the destination with the host in bold, and a host with look-alike letters is shown in its ASCII form under a warning, as is a user name hiding in front of the host. Continue is a real link that opens a new tab with noopener noreferrer, and Go back has focus; when the dialog closes, focus returns to the link or button that was clicked. The dialog never grows taller than the screen: it scrolls. trustedHosts match exactly or as *.example.com. onTrust(host) adds the Don't ask again for this site box, so you decide how to store it. onContinue and onCancel report the answer. ExternalLinkPanel is the inside on its own.
